items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: The interviewee mentions Johnny Lepore only in the context of another musician (Alfred) being 'good outside of Johnny Lepore' and discusses Tony Peretti working with Johnny, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction between himself and Johnny Lepore.

ctx.x: Do you remember Johnny Detroit's band, Cobbs? That was one.

Yes, we were playing with the Owls then when Johnny was at Cub. It was El Straticus and he had, who else was with El Straticus and... Well his brother probably, Paul. Probably Paul, yeah, his brother on drums. And now who... Probably Tony Peretti.
Huh? Probably Tony Peretti would be...
